notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0731 alpha-b151432
notes.notes: [h1]Improvements to the Vehicle Assembly Building[/h1][p]We have improved the functionality of the Vehicle Assembly Building where rockets are assembled.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/6543256b36022f6a73adeb4a4188ece570c5761f.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Registering user texture images[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/8d75e43cb9e05354a992aeec265d1242d3c06f31.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can register your favorite texture images from the “Texture” menu at the top of the screen.[/p][p]The texture images registered here can be applied to rocket parts.[/p][p][/p][h3]Parts Editor[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/d3831b7edd9e78ee3887875072eff72d3e3c35f3.png"][/img][/p][p]Right-clicking on a rocket part opens the Parts Editor. In the Parts Editor, you can change the color, texture, scale, and other properties.[/p][p][/p][h3]Linear Symmetry Placement[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/a3d21101ddf914dda8a167b4d77144314a496e00.png"][/img][/p][p]By selecting options such as ×3 or ×4 from the top of the screen, you can duplicate and place parts in linear symmetry.[/p]

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0703 alpha-b165837:Hot fix
notes.notes: [h1]A version with bug fixes will be released.[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/79ea80cca4aef707ca25f4835f0b51350326468c.jpg"][/img][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would crash when placing celestial bodies in the debug console.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved camera parallel movement in VAB.[/p][/*][*][p]We have enabled parallel movement of the camera by clicking the middle mouse button and dragging.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now select the era.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0630 alpha-b214915
notes.notes: [list][*][p]We made it possible to assemble rockets in the Vehicle Assembly Building (VAB) and launch them.[/p][/*][*][p]We made it possible to accelerate time during rocket launches.[/p][/*][*][p]We improved the freedom of camera operation at the rocket launch site.[/p][/*][*][p]We made it possible to save rocket launch parameters for each rocket.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/a934f9ecf0d0531331657b6eaab6cc8e23499a6b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/d906252a108befb821203a549173d9eeafa03bff.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0506 alpha-b213740
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/5c1c5e4e3772edbc9790d364e375c0e33bfb9cc9.jpg[/img]
[*] Added focus function for target of interest
When the camera mode is in orbit mode, you can now center the target celestial object.
[*] Planned orbit line drawing
Planned orbit line drawing after SOI change is now also performed. This function will be improved in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/6eae02c24f75c5aa576a13b0e82ce46252da49af.jpg[/img]
[*] Added space walk mini game
You can enjoy the space walk mini game from the ISS.
[*] Bug fixes
Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0325 alpha-b153308
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/08b39f47012cf90d7dc421453f35a53d68f3bf39.png[/img]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to create maneuver plans for lunar flyby trajectories.
[*] Added quick save (F5 key)/load (F9 key).
[*] Improved camera behavior when left-clicking and dragging in Free/Orbital camera mode.
[*] The SOI sphere displayed by the F3 key now only shows the targeted celestial body.
[*] The distance display unit has been abolished from mm to km.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=DLPqzpTLdrI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.notes:
